the research field is still in its infancy.
the relationship between quality and safety is complex, and that more research is needed to understand it.
food quality and food safety have become important issues in today’s consumer society, and that the consumer is willing to pay more for quality and safe products.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
food quality is an important factor in consumer food choice, and that consumers are willing to pay a premium for high quality food.
consumers are willing to pay more for food products with a high perceived quality and a low perceived risk.
consumers have a very complex perception of food quality, that this perception is linked to the safety of food, and that the perception influences food choice and demand.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the consumer is an important actor in the food chain.
consumer perception of food quality and safety is a multidisciplinary issue that requires an integrative approach to be understood and addressed.
food quality and food safety are central to food choice, and thus to food economics.
